author_or_org: Gaole He, Lucie Kuiper, Ujwal Gadiraju

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The study tested a tutorial intervention that reveals AI advice fallibility and logic units-based explanations to improve user understanding of AI advice.
claims.quote: Through an empirical study (N = 249), we explored the impact of DKE on human reliance on an AI system, and whether such effects can be mitigated using a tutorial intervention that reveals the fallibility of AI advice, and exploiting logic units-based explanations to improve user understanding of AI advice.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The paper states its work has broad implications for designing methods to tackle user cognitive biases while facilitating appropriate reliance on AI systems.
claims.quote: Our work has broad implications on the design of methods to tackle user cognitive biases while facilitating appropriate reliance on AI systems.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Participants who overestimate their performance tend to under-rely on AI systems, hindering optimal team performance.
claims.quote: We found that participants who overestimate their performance tend to exhibit under-reliance on AI systems, which hinders optimal team performance.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Logic units-based explanations did not improve calibration of competence or facilitate appropriate reliance.
claims.quote: Logic units-based explanations did not help users in either improving the calibration of their competence or facilitating appropriate reliance.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: A tutorial intervention was highly effective for participants with overestimated self-assessment but could hurt appropriate reliance for those with underestimated self-assessment.
claims.quote: While the tutorial intervention was highly effective in helping users calibrate their self-assessment and facilitating appropriate reliance among participants with overestimated self-assessment, we found that it can potentially hurt the appropriate reliance of participants with underestimated self-assessment.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Appropriate reliance is key to complementary team performance in AI-assisted decision making.
claims.quote: Recent research has shown that appropriate reliance is the key to achieving complementary team performance in AI-assisted decision making.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: DKE is a metacognitive bias in which less-competent individuals overestimate their own skill and performance.
claims.quote: DKE is a metacognitive bias due to which less-competent individuals overestimate their own skill and performance.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: The findings advance understanding of how self-assessment shapes trust and reliance in human-AI decision making.
claims.quote: Our findings advance the current understanding of the role of self-assessment in shaping trust and reliance in human-AI decision making.
